llc.formation_notes: Filed online via Fast Track Filing or by paper.

annual_report.name: Biennial Report
annual_report.due: odd-numbered years, between January 1 and April 1
annual_report.late_penalty: not stated on the fee page; paper filing costs $45

sources.title: Iowa SOS - Business Entity Forms and Fees
Iowa SOS - Biennial Report
sources.quote: LLCs, LLPs, and Nonprofit Corporations: Every Odd numbered year beginning January 1st and due by April 1st. The fee is $30* by online filing or $45* by paper.

entity_level_taxes.name: Corporate income tax on built-in gains and passive investment income only
entity_level_taxes.notes: Only when the S corp owes federal tax on these items; corporate rate 7.1% for 2024 or later (from the composite tax table). Otherwise S corps are not taxable entities in Iowa.

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Annual PTET election for partnerships and S corps (HF 352, 2023); rate 3.8% for 2025 (individual rate). After P.L. 119-21 the election is no longer scheduled to expire and remains available while the federal SALT limitation applies.

sources.title: Iowa DOR - Tax/Fee Descriptions and Rates (S Corporation Income Tax)
sources.quote: Generally, an S Corporation is not a taxable entity in Iowa, but the shareholders are taxed on their distributive shares

sources.title: Iowa DOR - Pass-Through Entity Tax (PTET)
sources.quote: Due to federal legislation, P.L. 119-21, the PTET election is no longer scheduled to expire.

personal_exemption.notes: $40 personal exemption credit per person (and per dependent); +$20 credit if 65+ or blind. No separate Iowa standard deduction: Iowa starts from federal taxable income, so the federal standard deduction applies implicitly. Filing threshold: net income over $9,000 single / $13,500 married.

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: School district income surtax (up to 20% of state tax, varies by district) and Appanoose County EMS surtax (1% of state tax) - see local_taxes.

sources.title: Iowa DOR - Iowa Tax Rate History
sources.quote: 2025 All brackets were eliminated. A single rate of 3.8% applied to all taxable income.

sources.title: Iowa DOR - composite tax rate for individual nonresident members
sources.quote: Estate, trust, S corporation, partnership, or individual 8.53% for 2022; 6% for 2023; 5.7% for 2024; 3.8% for 2025 or later

sources.title: Iowa DOR - IA 1040 Exemption Credits
sources.quote: Add the number of personal credits and multiply by $40.

estimated_tax.required_if: you expect to owe $1,000 or more (raised from $200 for tax years beginning on or after Jan 1, 2026) in tax on income not subject to withholding
estimated_tax.notes: Iowa uses end-of-month dates (April 30, June 30, Sept 30, Jan 31); next business day if weekend/holiday

unemployment_2026.notes: 2026 wage base dropped to $20,400 from $39,500 in 2025; Table D (lowest) in effect; new construction employers 5.4%

local_taxes.name: School district income surtax
local_taxes.applies: Iowa residents, computed as a percentage of state income tax liability, collected on the IA 1040
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: Varies by school district, not to exceed 20% of state income tax; district list on the DOR income tax forms page
local_taxes.quote: Tax Rate: Not to exceed 20% of state income tax liability. The rate is different for each school district.

local_taxes.name: Emergency medical services income surtax
local_taxes.applies: county residents, as a percentage of state income tax liability
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: 1% of state tax, not of income
local_taxes.quote: Only Appanoose County imposes this tax (at a rate of 1%) at this time.

notable: Flat 3.8% on federal taxable income since 2025 (https://revenue.iowa.gov/resources/law-policy-information/iowa-tax-rate-history)

Estimated tax threshold raised to $1,000 from 2026, and quarterly dates are the last day of April, June, September and January (https://revenue.iowa.gov/taxes/tax-guidance/individual-income-tax/estimated-income-tax-payments)
SUTA wage base cut to $20,400 for 2026, new employers 1.0% (https://workforce.iowa.gov/media/1278/download?inline)
LLC costs are low: $50 to form, $30 online biennial report (https://sos.iowa.gov/business/FormsAndFees.html)
School district surtax adds up to 20% of the state tax bill (https://revenue.iowa.gov/taxes/tax-guidance/general/iowa-taxfee-descriptions-and-rates)
uncertain: No DOR page states the 2026 individual rate in words; 3.8% applies to 2025 'or later' per the composite rate table and rate history. No 2026 law change was found.
Biennial report late penalty not found.
Corporate rate for built-in gains (7.1%) is read from the composite tax table for C corporations; Iowa corporate rate schedule not checked separately.
